features.description: Procedure template notebook with documented steps (configure, load, diagnostics, battery, report) and markdown cells citing academic rationale and the report-only no-decision discipline; runs end-to-end via nbmake on bundled sample data
features.expectedBehavior: nbmake executes the notebook exit 0 and a report file is produced; markdown cells document each step and the anti-p-hacking stance

features.description: Runner orchestrator run_battery() that calls assumptions + all tests + effect sizes from a single call given InputSpec and RunConfig, returning all results and writing the report
features.expectedBehavior: One call produces all results and a report file on bundled sample data; no method silently skipped

features.description: TestResult schema dataclass and Markdown report writer producing a summary table (one row per test) plus per-test sections with citations and assumption outcomes, and a JSON sidecar
features.expectedBehavior: All battery results conform to TestResult schema; Markdown parses with one summary row per method; JSON sidecar round-trips results

features.description: Effect sizes: Cohen's d and Hedges' g (with bias correction), Cliff's delta, rank-biserial correlation, and Hodges-Lehmann estimator with CIs and citations
features.expectedBehavior: Cohen's d and Hedges' g match pingouin to tolerance with g differing by small-sample correction; Cliff's delta in [-1,1] matching pingouin; rank-biserial matches reference; Hodges-Lehmann matches scipy.stats.hodgeslehmann with CI bracketing estimate

features.description: JZS Bayes factor via pingouin returning BF10 and BF01, citation (Rouder et al. 2009), and the prior width used (from config)
features.expectedBehavior: BF10 finite and positive on synthetic data; matches pingouin.bayesfactor_ttest to tolerance; prior width from config

features.description: BEST Bayesian t-test (Kruschke 2013) via PyMC with ArviZ: posterior mean difference, HDI, ROPE proportion, MCMC diagnostics (R-hat, ESS), draws/chains, seed, citation; no decision
features.expectedBehavior: Posterior mean difference finite and within data range; R-hat < 1.01 and ESS > 400 on bundled sample data; reproducible given seed; ROPE proportion in [0,1]; no decision string

features.description: Permutation test (exact for small n, Monte Carlo for large n) and bootstrap CI for the mean difference, both seed-reproducible with iteration counts and citations
features.expectedBehavior: Exact permutation matches exhaustive enumeration; Monte Carlo reproducible given seed; bootstrap CI brackets estimate and is reproducible; CI level from config

features.description: Rank-based non-parametric tests: Mann-Whitney U and Brunner-Munzel, returning statistic, p-value, citation, assumption notes; no decision
features.expectedBehavior: Results match scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu and scipy.stats.brunnermunzel to tolerance on synthetic data

features.description: Frequentist parametric tests: Student's t (equal variance), Welch's t (unequal variance), and z-test (known variance supplied via config), each returning statistic, p-value, dof/CI, citation, assumption notes; no decision
features.expectedBehavior: t-tests match scipy.stats.ttest_ind to tolerance; z-test matches analytical result with known variance; missing variance raises explicit error; CIs bracket mean difference

features.description: Variance homogeneity (Levene, Bartlett, Brown-Forsythe) and outlier flagging (IQR/z-score rule) reporting indices without removing data
features.expectedBehavior: All three variance tests return finite results on equal/unequal variance data; outlier indices reported; original data unchanged

features.description: Normality diagnostics: Shapiro-Wilk, Anderson-Darling, D'Agostino K^2, each returning statistic, p-value, citation, and assumption outcome with no decision applied
features.expectedBehavior: All three normality tests return finite statistics and p-values in [0,1] on normal and skewed data; citations present; no decision rule

features.description: data_io.load() reading CSV/parquet/in-memory arrays, validating inputs (non-empty, numeric, finite, min sample size), and computing a deterministic data hash for provenance
features.expectedBehavior: load() handles CSV, parquet, and array inputs; invalid inputs raise typed errors; deterministic hash recorded

features.description: RunConfig and InputSpec dataclasses with all tunable parameters and documented defaults, plus the academic citations registry mapping every method to a reference
features.expectedBehavior: RunConfig covers alpha, CI level, HDI mass, ROPE width, MCMC draws/chains, permutation iterations, bootstrap iterations, seed; InputSpec accepts paths or arrays; citations registry has an entry for every battery method

features.description: UV project scaffold, pyproject.toml with pinned deps, twosample_means package skeleton with all module files and __init__.py
features.expectedBehavior: uv sync succeeds; import twosample_means works; all modules from architecture.md exist (may be stubs with docstrings)
